raw:
I picked the ten below, mostly on saturation or redundancy grounds. Nine are "lower" because a strong parent leaves less headroom for the edit. The one "higher" case (removing edge 3 when edge 4 is a strong conv) is a redundancy story: edge 4 is a strong alternative path, so removing edge 3 hurts less.

I dropped hypotheses whose condition is the rare `none` op, since they are mostly connectivity stories. I also dropped "replacing a good op with a worse one loses accuracy", which is the expected average effect rather than an interaction.

The picks cover edits on all six edges and three edit ops (3x3 conv, 1x1 conv, none), which meets the diversity requirement.
